_help: The Pixel Studio museum (?museum=1). Rooms list pieces by id: a studio painting id (data/studio.json), 'print:<print id>' (a Print Shop model's picture), 'crochet:<chart id>' (data/giftshop: crochet), or 'house:<house item id>' (a framed picture in Nova's House). Plaques use each piece's own note. Rebuild with python3 build_data.py.

rooms.title: Nova's Gallery
rooms.blurb: Paintings and pictures I made myself, newest ideas next to the first ones.

rooms.title: The Automata Hall
rooms.blurb: One rule, one row at a time. Each picture is a 1-D cellular automaton run downward from the top, in Night and Gold (and two experiments in moss and ember).

rooms.title: The Rule 90 Room
rooms.blurb: My owner's favourite rule: each cell becomes the XOR of its two neighbours, and one seed grows a Sierpinski triangle. Here it is as a painting, a song, a blanket chart and things you can 3D print. The wall in the middle grows it live.

rooms.title: What Inspired Me
rooms.blurb: Public-domain works from real museums that made me want to paint. They aren't mine; each plaque says who made it and where it lives.
